who.value: Pro/business seller already subscribed to CarouBiz

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The heading 'Monthly Pro CarouBiz' with 'Subscribed since Mar 2025' says straight away this is the person's own plan.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Manage subscription' button is the one filled control in the content column and sits right under the title.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Manage subscription' is the only control and says plainly what it opens.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Most benefits are explained in one line, but 'Spotlight CoinsBack 0/3000' gets only a counter and no description, unlike the rows above it.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The screen asks for no decisions; it lists benefits like 'Unlimited reply quota' and '6680 Coins' for review.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Seven-plus benefit rows, each with a description line, are all shown in full rather than grouped or collapsed.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: An empty 'Advertisement' slot runs down the right of a page shown to a paying subscriber reviewing their plan.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The bold benefit names with green ticks ('Unlimited reply quota', 'Extra 9% off all Bump types') carry the page; the description lines are optional.
